name: Magic Wand Reveal
description: A row of overlapping tilted tiles hides blurred images that sharpen and fade in as a magic wand follows the cursor across them, with the wand tilting by pointer position.
contents: Row of overlapping rotated square tiles with placeholder image icon
Image inside each tile revealed by pointer position
Wand shape that follows the pointer
behavior: Wand follows the mouse with a smoothed animation and tilts left to right
Each tile image goes from blurred and transparent to sharp and opaque as the wand passes over it
Touch dragging drives the same effect
All sizes use vmin units so it scales with the viewport
editableByProps: Wand and tile sizes, wand follow speed

needsCodeEdit.change: Change tile tilt angles or overlap
needsCodeEdit.where: rotations array and marginClass inside images.map
wandRef div with its linear-gradient backgrounds

fixed: Fills the full viewport height with its own background
Listens to window mouse and touch movement while mounted and removes the listeners on unmount
Tiles are laid out with vmin units and are designed for 4 images
